text: The tribe left to follow someone with fewer ideas. You kept the cave. It kept you.
The whole tribe crowded into your corner of the cave to be near you. You were at the bottom.
You forgot to eat. Your mother was right. She will bring it up at the funeral.
The tribe had never had so much meat. You were first in line and last to stop.
Nobody believed in the Gods anymore. The Gods noticed. Lightning found you in the open.
The tribe decided you were a god. Gods live in the volcano.
The fire went out. Then the nights got longer. Then the wolves got braver.
The fire grew until it made its own weather. You made the mistake of standing near it.
Everyone moved to the village over. They had the round thing.
The village grew so big it needed someone to blame for everything. It picked you.
The harvest failed. You ate next year's seeds. Next year did not go well.
So much grain the barn burst. You were in the barn.
The priests declared you cursed. Nobody would trade with you, look at you, or feed you.
The priests adored you so much they built you into the temple wall. For luck.
The neighbours came over the hill. They brought the round thing. It had spikes on now.
The neighbours admired you so much they moved in. All of them. Into your house.
It rolled away. You chased it downhill, into the river.
notes: Special death from the wheel's trigger answer.
